newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN 1996 estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN 1996 estimate raised.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said it raised its 1996 earnings estimates for Brazilian steelmaker Cia Siderurgica Nacional's (CSN) Level One American Depositary Receipt (ADR) and cut its 1997 estimate, but maintained its neutral rating on the security.
-- The brokerage said it raised its 1996 estimate to $1.82 per ADR from $1.29 and cuts its 1997 estimate to $0.75 from $2.58.
-- It said it raised its 1996 estimate due to higher-than-expected cost reductions and overall improvements in production.
-- It said CSN's profits should decrease in 1997 due to lower financial revenues and higher financial expenses as a result of new loans related to non-core business investments.
-- CSN's common share was off 0.10 real at 22.20 reais at 1304 local/1204 EDT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
